uncited: This family is distinguished from [Procedural and implicit volumes](13-procedural-and-implicit-volumes.md) by producing an explicit, sampled grid rather than an analytic function, and from [Acquisition](14-acquisition.md) by being a computational conversion step rather than a physical sensing process.
All methods in this family map continuous world-space coordinates to discrete integer grid indices $(i, j, k)$.
**Coordinate Mapping**: Defining a grid resolution (number of cells per axis) and a bounding box (origin and extent).
**Occupancy Determination**: Evaluating whether a specific voxel cell intersects with, contains, or is influenced by the input primitive.
**Attribute Assignment**: Storing data in the voxel.
